lemmas.title: Admissible Increment
lemmas.statement: An increment Delta_x is admissible if and only if it satisfies the admissibility condition Pi_A evaluated against local residue R and participation E_alpha.

lemmas.title: Pre-update Constraint Precedence
lemmas.statement: Legality evaluation and admissibility filtering must precede the application of state updates.

lemmas.title: Residue-conditioned Closure Constraint
lemmas.statement: The closure of a process chain is determined by the mutual consistency of residue inscriptions across all constituent transitions.
